cost.basis: Historical measured all-arm A40 study range requested previously; projections, not billed compute. Mean and p90 include all streams including primary failures and followup. Simulation/model costs zero.

broad_75.meaning: 75% ties overall across nine, as signed historical fixture

measured.meaning: Measured dev plug-in rates; zeros elsewhere historical assumptions, not proof

regression_metric: non-promotion by any route; identification separate; small silent regressions reported separately without inventing a new target

sampling.G1: zero tolerance, recorded zero-misfire fixture; not a claim of population safety
sampling.G2: single-stage t=0 on complete coverage, all answer net counts nonnegative; safety strata covered by G1
sampling.coverage: Only uncovered answer strata. Select least-observed uncovered stratum; equal-count ties resolved by answer-index rotated by initial offset modulo6. Primary observations count. A stratum is covered at >=10 discordances OR zero discordances and >=60 observations. Covered strata are dropped; no model-based equivalence assumption.
sampling.pooled_e: bet .3, threshold20, frozen after primary acceptance; no coverage-stage resurrection of rejected primary
sampling.primary: balanced all nine; rotating initial offset stream_index modulo9; until e>=20 or300 items, retaining prior futility e<=.05, net>=3 and all-nine-observed conditions
sampling.risk_followup: Unconditional40 dissenter items after every primary acceptance, even if coverage incomplete or G2 fails; G1 immediate safety veto; risk-net<0 rejects. Structural both-correct ties in recorded fixture.

scenario_scope: never_worse only measured; silent regressions narrow and measured, not broad which has no silent stratum; good085/good090/neutral/harmful/H0/regression all fixtures

scenarios.regression: one active answer stratum p=.30, rotates; other active strata p=.91875
scenarios.silent_regression_05: one originally silent answer stratum rotates, per-item loss-only discordance .05; agreement p=.85

silent_bound.certificate: Zero discordances among a predeclared first60 observations; if primary samples beyond60 and later discordance occurs, the terminal silent branch is invalidated. Report ever-obtained first60 certificate separately from terminal bound activation. Primary may stop before60; no certificate then.
silent_bound.limits: IID stationary per-stratum paired outcomes required. Marginal95%, not simultaneous across six, not equivalence. Report bound activation for the deliberately regressed silent stratum separately from any silent stratum.

targets.qualification: All four profiles in BOTH seed sets must meet all four targets; measured p1 also reported. No averaging across fixtures.

verification: 100 streams per cell independently replayed through scalar Process; counts, discordance, net, primary accept, coverage, promotion and items match. G1/G2/followup unit tests separate.
